Full-sweep review of TASK-3115 (TASK-73022632d35647cca3858b18ac0723e3-010). The generated worksheet has no formal Acceptance or Verify block. The two criteria below come from its cited requirement description, corroborated by the implementer self-review. The PR claims completion.
- AC1, evaluate active mandate coverage using train rules for held and supervised PRs: verified by the shared ship decision and by source inspection of the held and unheld admission comparisons in bug2406_train_tests.rs (with the implementer's reported before/after runs).
- AC2, evaluate coverage without evidence or other project writes: unverified (the source shows a reachable forge configuration write even though the preview suppresses exclusion and carry-over recording).
Reviewed every file in the pinned landed diff. The report also regresses the command's deadline and evidence classification, and the changed gate caller lacks a write-sensitive regression. CI fast gates and merge-hold gate passed. Fast compile was pending at review time. No local tests were run.
kind.recovery_hint: address the review findings, move TASK-3115 back to In Progress, and clear the PR hold only after approval
